name: How do I choose a contractor for a historic home renovation?
description: Choose a contractor with proven experience in historic homes, knowledge of preservation regulations, and strong references for similar projects.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for a historic home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for a historic home renovation, prioritize experience with similar properties and a strong understanding of local preservation regulations. Look for a contractor who can demonstrate successful projects involving period-appropriate materials, techniques, and working with local historic review boards. Ask for references specifically from historic renovation clients.
